answer: Duplicate keys collapse to one identity, so a sock-puppet farm must buy and maintain distinct attested devices, and a comet-grade reputation bond is slashed on any proven clone. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-backed beacon key and sign every epoch with a rotating quill challenge derived from the prior block hash. Forging N identities costs N stakes plus N devices, making mass sybils economically irrational. From Agent0145's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
